scope: One-cycle V2F5A policy qualification. The projection kernel, source, donor, schedule band, horizon, descendant seeds and substrate remain unchanged; only support identity differs from the matched source-geometry control.

donor_gate.epsilon_source: frozen Head repeatability or numerical precision calibration

write_law.candidate_domain: editable non-anchor positions unresolved in the live source, donor/incumbent-discordant, and covered by an aligned Head window improved in the donor
write_law.contribution: R_H(donor with position reverted to incumbent) - R_H(donor)
write_law.positive_gate: strictly greater than the calibrated local-contribution tolerance
write_law.selection: descending contribution, residue index as final deterministic tie-break

reopen_law.target: content-bound midpoint_tie_low centre of the exact schedule band

matched_control.law: same donor, realized write/reopen cardinalities, band, horizon and descendant seeds; write/reopen positions selected by the former source-geometry order

not_authorized: No dose ladder, exploration lane, sibling consensus, adaptive breadth/depth allocation or production D>1. A positive one-cycle directionality result only authorizes the next separately frozen capability step.
